shared_elements: carved relief on an upright slab/panel
hatched or incised surface texturing (scale-like/striated infill)
justification: Both are upright relief panels containing profile humanoid figures with striated/hatched infill and some handled or carried objects, but that is about as generic as figural relief gets. B shows one large, anatomically modelled figure in a fish-skin cloak with raised hand and a bucket, dominating the field, whereas A is a crowded field of small, flat, schematic curvilinear forms (boat- or animal-like shapes, chevron and hatch clusters) with no comparable single dominant figure or attribute.
